name: Dodgy
body:
You can dodge the melee attacks of Medium or larger foes.

Prerequisite: Kval, Dex 15.

Benefit: You gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC against the melee attacks of Medium or larger foes.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
